passportFacts.title: Burj Khalifa
passportFacts.text: Dubai's Burj Khalifa became the world's tallest building in 2010.

passportFacts.title: United Arab Emirates
passportFacts.text: Seven emirates make up this country, formed as a federation in 1971.

passportFacts.title: Emirates Mars Mission
passportFacts.text: Its Hope probe entered orbit around Mars in 2021.

passportFacts.title: Lionel Messi
passportFacts.text: Lionel Messi grew up in Rosario and captained this country to the 2022 men's World Cup title.

passportFacts.title: Eva Perón
passportFacts.text: Eva Perón, the political figure behind the musical Evita, was its first lady.

passportFacts.title: Tango
passportFacts.text: Along with Uruguay, this country helped give the world tango.

passportFacts.title: Sydney Opera House
passportFacts.text: Its best-known opera house has a roof often compared to sails.

passportFacts.title: Steve Irwin
passportFacts.text: Wildlife presenter Steve Irwin became famous as the Crocodile Hunter here.

passportFacts.title: AC/DC
passportFacts.text: The rock band AC/DC formed in Sydney in this country.

passportFacts.title: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
passportFacts.text: Mozart was born in Salzburg, in what is now this country.

passportFacts.title: The Sound of Music (film)
passportFacts.text: The Sound of Music follows the von Trapp family in this country.

passportFacts.title: Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria
passportFacts.text: Vienna was the seat of the Habsburg rulers; the assassination of heir Franz Ferdinand helped spark World War I.

passportFacts.title: Bangladesh Liberation War
passportFacts.text: This country became independent from Pakistan after a war in 1971.

passportFacts.title: Muhammad Yunus
passportFacts.text: Muhammad Yunus and Grameen Bank won the Nobel Peace Prize for work on microcredit here.

passportFacts.title: Bengali language movement
passportFacts.text: A movement defending Bengali helped inspire International Mother Language Day.

passportFacts.title: Pelé
passportFacts.text: Pelé won three men's World Cups playing for this country.

passportFacts.title: Rio Carnival
passportFacts.text: Rio de Janeiro hosts its famous carnival of samba schools and parades.

passportFacts.title: Bossa nova
passportFacts.text: The musical style bossa nova developed here; The Girl from Ipanema became a worldwide hit.

passportFacts.title: Celine Dion
passportFacts.text: Céline Dion was born in Quebec in this country.

passportFacts.title: Toronto Raptors
passportFacts.text: The Toronto Raptors became the first NBA champions based outside the United States.

passportFacts.title: Terry Fox
passportFacts.text: Terry Fox attempted to run across this country to raise money for cancer research.

passportFacts.title: Pablo Neruda
passportFacts.text: Nobel Prize-winning poet Pablo Neruda came from this country.

passportFacts.title: 2010 Copiapó mining accident
passportFacts.text: The world watched as 33 trapped miners were rescued here in 2010.

passportFacts.title: Easter Island
passportFacts.text: Rapa Nui, famous for its giant moai statues, is part of this country.

passportFacts.title: Terracotta Army
passportFacts.text: Thousands of terracotta soldiers guarded the tomb of its first emperor.

passportFacts.title: Great Wall of China
passportFacts.text: A vast network of defensive walls stretches across its northern landscape.

passportFacts.title: Mao Zedong
passportFacts.text: Mao Zedong proclaimed its People's Republic in 1949.

passportFacts.title: Shakira
passportFacts.text: Shakira was born in Barranquilla in this country.

passportFacts.title: Gabriel García Márquez
passportFacts.text: Gabriel García Márquez, author of One Hundred Years of Solitude, was born here.

passportFacts.title: Encanto
passportFacts.text: Disney's Encanto is set in this country.

passportFacts.title: Velvet Revolution
passportFacts.text: The peaceful Velvet Revolution ended communist rule in its predecessor state in 1989.

passportFacts.title: Franz Kafka
passportFacts.text: Franz Kafka was born in Prague, now this country's capital.

passportFacts.title: Pilsner Urquell
passportFacts.text: The golden lager style called pilsner began in the city of Plzeň here.

passportFacts.title: Fall of the Berlin Wall
passportFacts.text: A wall dividing its best-known city opened in November 1989.

passportFacts.title: Ludwig van Beethoven
passportFacts.text: Beethoven was born in Bonn, in what is now this country.

passportFacts.title: Johannes Gutenberg
passportFacts.text: Gutenberg developed his influential movable-type printing system in Mainz here.

passportFacts.title: The Lego Group
passportFacts.text: LEGO began as a small workshop in Billund in this country.

passportFacts.title: Hans Christian Andersen
passportFacts.text: Hans Christian Andersen wrote The Little Mermaid and The Ugly Duckling here.

passportFacts.title: Niels Bohr
passportFacts.text: Physicist Niels Bohr, known for his model of the atom, was born in its capital.

passportFacts.title: Tutankhamun
passportFacts.text: The discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb made headlines around the world.

passportFacts.title: Suez Canal
passportFacts.text: The Suez Canal links the Mediterranean and Red Sea through this country.

passportFacts.title: Cleopatra
passportFacts.text: Cleopatra VII was its last active Ptolemaic ruler.

passportFacts.title: Pablo Picasso
passportFacts.text: Picasso was born in Málaga in this country.

passportFacts.title: Don Quixote
passportFacts.text: Cervantes set Don Quixote's windmill-tilting adventures here.

passportFacts.title: 2010 FIFA World Cup final
passportFacts.text: An Andrés Iniesta goal won this country its first men's World Cup in 2010.

passportFacts.title: Lucy (hominid)
passportFacts.text: The ancient human relative nicknamed Lucy was discovered here.

passportFacts.title: Abebe Bikila
passportFacts.text: Abebe Bikila won the 1960 Olympic marathon barefoot while representing this country.

passportFacts.title: Battle of Adwa
passportFacts.text: Its victory at Adwa in 1896 defeated an invading Italian army.

passportFacts.title: French Revolution
passportFacts.text: The storming of the Bastille became a symbol of its 1789 revolution.

passportFacts.title: Napoleon
passportFacts.text: Napoleon rose from army officer to emperor of this country.

passportFacts.title: Tour de France
passportFacts.text: The world's most famous multi-stage bicycle race is chiefly held here.

passportFacts.title: The Beatles
passportFacts.text: The Beatles formed in Liverpool in this country.

passportFacts.title: William Shakespeare
passportFacts.text: William Shakespeare was born in Stratford-upon-Avon here.

passportFacts.title: Winston Churchill
passportFacts.text: Winston Churchill led its government through much of World War II.

passportFacts.title: Kwame Nkrumah
passportFacts.text: Kwame Nkrumah led this country to independence from Britain in 1957.

passportFacts.title: Kofi Annan
passportFacts.text: Former UN secretary-general Kofi Annan was born in Kumasi here.

passportFacts.title: Kente cloth
passportFacts.text: Its brightly patterned kente cloth is woven in strips and often worn for celebrations.

passportFacts.title: Ancient Olympic Games
passportFacts.text: The ancient Olympic Games began at Olympia here.

passportFacts.title: Socrates
passportFacts.text: Socrates taught and questioned fellow citizens in ancient Athens here.

passportFacts.title: Mamma Mia! (film)
passportFacts.text: The film Mamma Mia! used islands such as Skopelos for its seaside setting.

passportFacts.title: 2018 FIFA World Cup final
passportFacts.text: Luka Modrić captained this country to the 2018 men's World Cup final.

passportFacts.title: Game of Thrones
passportFacts.text: Dubrovnik's walls stood in for King's Landing in Game of Thrones.

passportFacts.title: Nikola Tesla
passportFacts.text: Nikola Tesla was born in Smiljan, a village in what is now this country.

passportFacts.title: Ernő Rubik
passportFacts.text: The inventor of the Rubik's Cube, Ernő Rubik, came from this country.

passportFacts.title: Hungarian Revolution of 1956
passportFacts.text: Soviet forces crushed an uprising in its capital in 1956.

passportFacts.title: Harry Houdini
passportFacts.text: Escape artist Harry Houdini was born in Budapest here.

passportFacts.title: Komodo dragon
passportFacts.text: Wild Komodo dragons live on a handful of islands in this country.

passportFacts.title: Proclamation of Indonesian Independence
passportFacts.text: Sukarno and Mohammad Hatta proclaimed its independence in 1945.

passportFacts.title: Bali
passportFacts.text: The island of Bali is one of its best-known destinations.

passportFacts.title: Mahatma Gandhi
passportFacts.text: Gandhi's campaigns of nonviolent resistance helped it win independence from Britain.

passportFacts.title: Hindi cinema
passportFacts.text: Mumbai is the center of the Hindi film industry nicknamed Bollywood.

passportFacts.title: Taj Mahal
passportFacts.text: An emperor built the Taj Mahal here as a tomb for his wife Mumtaz Mahal.

passportFacts.title: U2
passportFacts.text: The rock band U2 formed in Dublin here.

passportFacts.title: James Joyce
passportFacts.text: James Joyce set Ulysses in its capital.

passportFacts.title: Guinness
passportFacts.text: The Guinness brewery began at St James's Gate in its capital.

passportFacts.title: Iranian Revolution
passportFacts.text: A revolution overthrew the shah here in 1979.

passportFacts.title: Persepolis
passportFacts.text: The ruins of Persepolis recall the Achaemenid Persian Empire here.

passportFacts.title: A Separation
passportFacts.text: Asghar Farhadi's A Separation won this country its first Oscar for a foreign-language film.

passportFacts.title: Leonardo da Vinci
passportFacts.text: Leonardo da Vinci was born near Vinci, in what is now this country.

passportFacts.title: Colosseum
passportFacts.text: Gladiators once fought in the Colosseum in its capital.

passportFacts.title: Ferrari
passportFacts.text: Enzo Ferrari founded his famous sports-car company here.

passportFacts.title: Petra
passportFacts.text: Its rock-cut city of Petra appeared in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade.

passportFacts.title: The Martian (film)
passportFacts.text: Wadi Rum's desert stood in for Mars in The Martian.

passportFacts.title: Dead Sea
passportFacts.text: This country has an eastern shore on the Dead Sea.

passportFacts.title: Nintendo
passportFacts.text: Nintendo began in Kyoto as a maker of playing cards.

passportFacts.title: Studio Ghibli
passportFacts.text: Studio Ghibli made Spirited Away and My Neighbor Totoro here.

passportFacts.title: Hiroshima
passportFacts.text: Hiroshima and Nagasaki were struck by atomic bombs in 1945.

passportFacts.title: Eliud Kipchoge
passportFacts.text: Marathon runner Eliud Kipchoge represents this country.

passportFacts.title: Wangarĩ Maathai
passportFacts.text: Wangari Maathai founded the Green Belt Movement here and won the Nobel Peace Prize.

passportFacts.title: Maasai Mara
passportFacts.text: Its Maasai Mara reserve is famous for lions and migrating wildebeest.

passportFacts.title: Angkor Wat
passportFacts.text: Angkor Wat, a vast temple complex, appears on its national flag.

passportFacts.title: Khmer Rouge
passportFacts.text: Pol Pot's Khmer Rouge regime ruled this country in the 1970s.

passportFacts.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
passportFacts.text: The temple of Ta Prohm here was a filming location for Lara Croft: Tomb Raider.

passportFacts.title: BTS
passportFacts.text: BTS and BLACKPINK helped bring this country's pop music to a worldwide audience.

passportFacts.title: Parasite (2019 film)
passportFacts.text: Parasite became the first non-English-language film to win the Best Picture Oscar.

passportFacts.title: Squid Game
passportFacts.text: The television series Squid Game was made in this country.

passportFacts.title: Ceylon tea
passportFacts.text: Tea from this island is still widely sold under its former name, Ceylon.

passportFacts.title: 1996 Cricket World Cup final
passportFacts.text: Its men's cricket team won the 1996 World Cup, beating Australia in the final.

passportFacts.title: Sirimavo Bandaranaike
passportFacts.text: Sirimavo Bandaranaike became the world's first woman prime minister here.

passportFacts.title: 2022 FIFA World Cup
passportFacts.text: Its men's football team became Africa's first World Cup semifinalist in 2022.

passportFacts.title: Casablanca (film)
passportFacts.text: The classic film Casablanca is named after a city in this country.

passportFacts.title: Ibn Battuta
passportFacts.text: The great medieval traveler Ibn Battuta was born in Tangier here.

passportFacts.title: Frida Kahlo
passportFacts.text: Frida Kahlo painted self-portraits at her Blue House here.

passportFacts.title: Day of the Dead
passportFacts.text: Families remember loved ones with colorful Day of the Dead offerings here.

passportFacts.title: Chichen Itza
passportFacts.text: The Maya built the great stepped pyramid at Chichén Itzá here.

passportFacts.title: Petronas Towers
passportFacts.text: Kuala Lumpur's twin Petronas Towers became a symbol of this country.

passportFacts.title: Michelle Yeoh
passportFacts.text: Oscar-winning actor Michelle Yeoh was born in Ipoh here.

passportFacts.title: Malayan Declaration of Independence
passportFacts.text: Tunku Abdul Rahman proclaimed Malaya's independence in 1957; it later became part of this country.

passportFacts.title: Edvard Munch
passportFacts.text: Edvard Munch, the artist behind The Scream, came from this country.

passportFacts.title: Roald Amundsen
passportFacts.text: Explorer Roald Amundsen led the first expedition to reach the South Pole for this country.

passportFacts.title: A-ha
passportFacts.text: The band a-ha, known for Take On Me, formed here.

passportFacts.title: Mount Everest
passportFacts.text: Mount Everest rises on its border with China.

passportFacts.title: The Buddha
passportFacts.text: Lumbini, traditionally recognized as the Buddha's birthplace, is here.

passportFacts.title: Gurkha
passportFacts.text: Gurkha soldiers take their name from the town of Gorkha in this country.

passportFacts.title: The Lord of the Rings (film series)
passportFacts.text: Peter Jackson filmed his Lord of the Rings trilogy here.

passportFacts.title: New Zealand national rugby union team
passportFacts.text: Its All Blacks rugby team performs a haka before matches.

passportFacts.title: Women's suffrage in New Zealand
passportFacts.text: In 1893 it became the first self-governing country to give women the vote in parliamentary elections.

passportFacts.title: Frankincense
passportFacts.text: Its Dhofar region is famous for the ancient frankincense trade.

passportFacts.title: Qaboos bin Said
passportFacts.text: Sultan Qaboos ruled this country from 1970 until 2020.

passportFacts.title: Strait of Hormuz
passportFacts.text: Its Musandam peninsula helps form the southern side of the Strait of Hormuz.

passportFacts.title: Malala Yousafzai
passportFacts.text: Education campaigner Malala Yousafzai was born in Mingora here.

passportFacts.title: 1992 Cricket World Cup final
passportFacts.text: Imran Khan captained this country to the 1992 men's Cricket World Cup title.

passportFacts.title: Mohenjo-daro
passportFacts.text: The ancient Indus Valley city of Mohenjo-daro is here.

passportFacts.title: Machu Picchu
passportFacts.text: The Inca built Machu Picchu high in its Andes mountains.

passportFacts.title: Nazca lines
passportFacts.text: Huge ancient figures called the Nazca Lines are etched into its desert.

passportFacts.title: Paddington Bear
passportFacts.text: Paddington Bear is said to come from this country.

passportFacts.title: Marie Curie
passportFacts.text: Marie Curie was born in Warsaw, now this country's capital.

passportFacts.title: Solidarity (Polish trade union)
passportFacts.text: Lech Wałęsa and the Solidarity movement challenged communist rule here.

passportFacts.title: Frédéric Chopin
passportFacts.text: Composer Frédéric Chopin was born near Warsaw here.

passportFacts.title: Cristiano Ronaldo
passportFacts.text: Cristiano Ronaldo was born on Madeira, an island belonging to this country.

passportFacts.title: Vasco da Gama
passportFacts.text: Vasco da Gama sailed from here to India around the Cape of Good Hope.

passportFacts.title: Carnation Revolution
passportFacts.text: The Carnation Revolution ended its dictatorship in 1974.

passportFacts.title: Dracula
passportFacts.text: Bram Stoker's Dracula made its region of Transylvania famous around the world.

passportFacts.title: Nadia Comăneci
passportFacts.text: Nadia Comăneci earned the first perfect 10 in Olympic gymnastics for this country.

passportFacts.title: Romanian revolution
passportFacts.text: A revolution overthrew Nicolae Ceaușescu here in 1989.

passportFacts.title: Sadio Mané
passportFacts.text: Footballer Sadio Mané helped this country win its first Africa Cup of Nations title.

passportFacts.title: Léopold Sédar Senghor
passportFacts.text: Poet Léopold Sédar Senghor became its first president after independence.

passportFacts.title: Dakar Rally
passportFacts.text: The original Paris-Dakar Rally ended in this country's capital.

passportFacts.title: ABBA
passportFacts.text: ABBA won Eurovision with Waterloo while representing this country.

passportFacts.title: Alfred Nobel
passportFacts.text: Alfred Nobel, whose fortune funded the Nobel Prizes, was born here.

passportFacts.title: Minecraft
passportFacts.text: The video game Minecraft was created by Markus Persson in this country.

passportFacts.title: Siam
passportFacts.text: This country was formerly known internationally as Siam.

passportFacts.title: Songkran (Thailand)
passportFacts.text: Its Songkran New Year celebrations are famous for water splashing.

passportFacts.title: The Beach (film)
passportFacts.text: The film The Beach used Maya Bay on Ko Phi Phi Le here.

passportFacts.title: Tunisian revolution
passportFacts.text: Protests here helped set off the Arab Spring in 2010–11.

passportFacts.title: Carthage
passportFacts.text: Ancient Carthage, Rome's great rival, stood near its modern capital.

passportFacts.title: Tataouine
passportFacts.text: Its desert locations helped portray Tatooine in the Star Wars films.

passportFacts.title: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk
passportFacts.text: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk founded its modern republic in 1923.

passportFacts.title: Hagia Sophia
passportFacts.text: Istanbul's Hagia Sophia began as a great Byzantine cathedral here.

passportFacts.title: Troy
passportFacts.text: The archaeological site associated with ancient Troy is here.

passportFacts.title: Freddie Mercury
passportFacts.text: Queen singer Freddie Mercury was born in Zanzibar, now part of this country.

passportFacts.title: Mount Kilimanjaro
passportFacts.text: Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest mountain, rises here.

passportFacts.title: Julius Nyerere
passportFacts.text: Julius Nyerere helped unite Tanganyika and Zanzibar into this country.

passportFacts.title: Apollo 11
passportFacts.text: Its Apollo 11 mission landed the first people on the Moon.

passportFacts.title: Martin Luther King Jr.
passportFacts.text: Martin Luther King Jr. delivered his I Have a Dream speech in its capital.

passportFacts.title: Hollywood
passportFacts.text: Hollywood became the center of its internationally influential film industry.

passportFacts.title: Samarkand
passportFacts.text: Silk Road merchants passed through its city of Samarkand, famed for its tiled monuments.

passportFacts.title: Timur
passportFacts.text: The conqueror Timur made Samarkand his capital and was buried there.

passportFacts.title: 1966 Tashkent earthquake
passportFacts.text: A devastating earthquake struck its capital Tashkent in 1966.

passportFacts.title: Fall of Saigon
passportFacts.text: The fall of Saigon in 1975 marked the end of a long war here.

passportFacts.title: Ho Chi Minh
passportFacts.text: Ho Chi Minh led its independence movement; its largest city now bears his name.

passportFacts.title: Pho
passportFacts.text: Phở, a soup of broth, rice noodles and herbs, originated here.

passportFacts.title: Nelson Mandela
passportFacts.text: Nelson Mandela became its president after the first fully democratic national election in 1994.

passportFacts.title: 1995 Rugby World Cup final
passportFacts.text: Its Springboks won the 1995 Rugby World Cup, a moment later dramatized in Invictus.

passportFacts.title: Desmond Tutu
passportFacts.text: Archbishop Desmond Tutu was a leading opponent of apartheid here.

passportFacts.title: Baikonur Cosmodrome
passportFacts.text: The Baikonur spaceport, which launched the first human into space, is in this country.

passportFacts.title: Kazakhstan
passportFacts.text: It is the world's largest landlocked country.

passportFacts.title: Astana
passportFacts.text: Its capital was renamed Nur-Sultan in 2019 and returned to the name Astana in 2022.

passportFacts.title: Eurovision Song Contest 2012
passportFacts.text: Baku hosted the Eurovision Song Contest in 2012 in this country.

passportFacts.title: Baku City Circuit
passportFacts.text: Formula One races through the streets of its capital Baku.

passportFacts.title: Gobustan State Historical and Cultural Reserve
passportFacts.text: Gobustan's ancient rock carvings record people, boats and animals near the Caspian Sea here.

passportFacts.title: Genghis Khan
passportFacts.text: Genghis Khan united nomadic tribes here before building an enormous empire.

passportFacts.title: Naadam
passportFacts.text: Its Naadam festival features wrestling, horse racing and archery.

passportFacts.title: Gobi Desert
passportFacts.text: Much of the Gobi Desert lies in this country, north of China.

passportFacts.title: 2006 Montenegrin independence referendum
passportFacts.text: It voted for independence from its union with Serbia in 2006.

passportFacts.title: Casino Royale (2006 film)
passportFacts.text: The high-stakes poker tournament in Casino Royale is set in this country.

passportFacts.title: Bay of Kotor
passportFacts.text: Mountains surround the Bay of Kotor on its Adriatic coast.

passportFacts.title: The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency
passportFacts.text: The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency novels are set here.

passportFacts.title: Okavango Delta
passportFacts.text: The Okavango River spreads into a huge inland delta here instead of reaching the sea.

passportFacts.title: Seretse Khama
passportFacts.text: Seretse Khama became its first president when it gained independence in 1966.

passportFacts.title: Namib
passportFacts.text: Its Namib Desert has some of the world's tallest sand dunes.

passportFacts.title: South African Border War
passportFacts.text: It gained independence from South African administration in 1990.

passportFacts.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
passportFacts.text: Much of Mad Max: Fury Road was filmed in its desert landscapes.

passportFacts.title: Public Force of Costa Rica
passportFacts.text: It abolished its standing army after a civil war in 1948.

passportFacts.title: Óscar Arias
passportFacts.text: Óscar Arias won the Nobel Peace Prize for a Central American peace plan while its president.

passportFacts.title: Geography of Costa Rica
passportFacts.text: This small Central American country is known for rainforests, sloths and exceptional biodiversity.

passportFacts.title: Singing Revolution
passportFacts.text: Mass singing gatherings helped its independence movement in the late 1980s.

passportFacts.title: Skype
passportFacts.text: The original Skype software was developed by a team based in this country.

passportFacts.title: E-Residency of Estonia
passportFacts.text: It pioneered an e-residency program for people running businesses online.

passportFacts.title: Salar de Uyuni
passportFacts.text: The vast salt flat Salar de Uyuni is here.

passportFacts.title: Simón Bolívar
passportFacts.text: This country is named after independence leader Simón Bolívar.

passportFacts.title: Lake Titicaca
passportFacts.text: It shares Lake Titicaca with Peru.

passportFacts.title: Galápagos Islands
passportFacts.text: Darwin visited its Galápagos Islands during the voyage of HMS Beagle.

passportFacts.title: Ecuador
passportFacts.text: Its name is the Spanish word for equator.

passportFacts.title: Panama hat
passportFacts.text: Despite their name, Panama hats are traditionally woven in this country.

passportFacts.title: Tikal
passportFacts.text: The Maya built the monumental city of Tikal in its rainforest.

passportFacts.title: Rigoberta Menchú
passportFacts.text: Indigenous rights campaigner Rigoberta Menchú won the Nobel Peace Prize for work rooted here.

passportFacts.title: Miguel Ángel Asturias
passportFacts.text: Nobel Prize-winning novelist Miguel Ángel Asturias came from this country.

passportFacts.title: 1930 FIFA World Cup
passportFacts.text: It hosted and won the first men's football World Cup in 1930.

passportFacts.title: José Mujica
passportFacts.text: Former president José Mujica became famous for his modest lifestyle.

passportFacts.title: La cumparsita
passportFacts.text: The famous tango La Cumparsita was composed in its capital Montevideo.

passportFacts.title: Bob Marley
passportFacts.text: Bob Marley helped carry reggae from this island to the world.

passportFacts.title: Usain Bolt
passportFacts.text: Sprinter Usain Bolt won eight Olympic gold medals representing this country.

passportFacts.title: Cool Runnings
passportFacts.text: Cool Runnings was inspired by its team's debut in Olympic bobsleigh.
